content.short: Aera is Gauntlet's onchain treasury protocol, letting DAOs hand day-to-day allocation to a guardian while keeping custody of their vault.
content.description: Aera was built by the risk team at Gauntlet for DAOs and protocols that hold large treasuries. The owner deposits assets into a vault, approves a guardian to rebalance between allowlisted DeFi venues, and never gives up custody. Available strategies range from earning on stablecoins and ETH to dampening treasury volatility, managing a protocol's own liquidity and paying out grants. Vaults run on Ethereum and Base, and every move the guardian makes is visible onchain. Vaults run on a guardian model: each guardian acts only within the assets and protocols the owner has allowlisted, and any transaction outside those limits is rejected. The code has been audited by Spearbit and OpenZeppelin.
